valueModes.kola: lossless bigint and bigint-backed nanosecond temporal wrappers
valueModes.tableTimestamps: fixture values are millisecond-aligned and one millisecond apart, so jkdb's default Date representation is value-equivalent; untimed q match preflight proves the round trip

publicTableRepresentations.kola: Apache Arrow Table returned by Kola's documented public API
publicTableRepresentations.jkdb: column-oriented object with Symbol.for("meta") table metadata returned by jkdb's documented public API

method.scheduling: persistent connections; one request at a time; measured client order follows ABBA blocks, reversed on alternating workloads, and is balanced for every permitted even sample count
method.p95: nearest-rank on raw durations; payload rateAtDurationP95 inverts duration p95
method.median: middle value, or arithmetic mean of the two middle values for an even sample count
method.logicalPayloadRate: canonical q serialized table bytes per second, based on the matching count -8!x preflight result; this is logical payload rate, not observed wire throughput
method.retainedMemory: noisy process-wide diagnostic only, not a client or library footprint claim; process.memoryUsage is sampled before and after retaining the configured result count, with forced GC at both snapshots, and allocator-wide deltas may be negative
method.diagnosticMemory: Kola raw Arrow IPC buffers and Arrow materialization are retained and measured separately; jkdb exposes no equivalent pre-materialization result
method.validation: every warmup and measured result is checked after its timed interval; before table timing, both prepared public representations must q-match the fixture by value and type and return the same canonical serialized size

bigint.jkdb: validated as bigint with useBigInt enabled

nonMillisecondTimestamp.jkdb: validated exact nanoseconds with includeNanosecond enabled
